description: This Dart file is the main entry point for a Flutter-based frontend application called 'store_manager_frontend'. It sets up the primary app structure with a MaterialApp widget, a home page, and a simple loading screen indicating that the app is being generated.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that initializes the MaterialApp for the Flutter application with a custom theme and a home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that represents the home page of the app, displaying a title.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: The state class for MyHomePage, building a scaffold with an app bar and centered loading message.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point function that runs the Flutter app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Overrides the build method to create the widget tree for MyApp and _MyHomePageState.
